podcasts.episode_description: Join Caroline Bach and Clay Reece as they discuss the life of a CUBESAT, alongside comets coming for Earth and the cinematic masterpiece that is Interstellar.
Join Caroline Bach and Ben Pumphrey as they dive into the legal processes behind how UGA's SSRL sends satellites to space.

Join Jillian Russell (MemeSat-1 Mission Operations Lead) and Vedika Ghildyal (Former Mission Operations Lead) as they give listeners an insight into being leadership on MOPS, while also discussing the annual Small Satellite Conference.

Join guest speakers Sam Penkava and Clay Reece (MEMESAT-1 Mission Operation team members) as they delve into the responsibilities of mission operations in a cubesat mission and their roles within the team. Stay tuned to hear about NASA's Psyche mission and what it means for space exploration, specifically within the asteroid belt.
